figurative_meaning_en: a little less or more; slight difference
example_sentences_in_bangla: রান্নায় ঝাল এতটুকু কমবেশী হওয়ার উপায় নেই।
এই দামে পণ্যের গুণমান কমবেশী তো হবেই।
example_sentences_in_english: In cooking, there's no way to get the spice level exactly right; it'll be a bit less or more.
At this price, the quality of the product will be a bit less or more.
note: Commonly used in contexts involving minor adjustments or inexactness in everyday activities like cooking or bargaining.
